items.headline: 316-unit apartment plan at 400 Saratoga Avenue golf course on Planning Commission agenda
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a recommendation on a General Plan amendment and rezone for a five-story, 316-unit apartment building at 400 Saratoga Avenue. The proposal would also reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course and dedicate land for a public park, and an EIR was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Gymnastics facility proposed in Corvin Drive warehouse
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a conditional use permit to let 7,116 square feet of an existing 16,576-square-foot warehouse at 3051 Corvin Drive be used as a gymnastics facility.

items.headline: Neighbor appeal of Rita Court home addition on agenda
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed an appeal of a staff-level approval for a 517-square-foot first-floor and 1,000-square-foot second-floor addition to a single-story home at 2261 Rita Court, on a 6,272-square-foot lot.

items.headline: 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space proposed near Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The agenda cited a CEQA exemption under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Council agenda: defer vote on 590-unit El Camino Real project
items.summary: The November 17 City Council/Stadium Authority agenda listed an action to defer consideration of a vesting tentative map and development agreement for a 590-residential-unit, 15,000-square-foot commercial mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real. The project is subject to SB 330 (2019).

items.headline: Council special meeting on Convention Center finances
items.summary: A 5:30 PM special City Council meeting on November 17 was set to give an overview of Santa Clara Convention Center financial status reports. They covered the fourth quarter of FY 2024/25 and all four quarters of FY 2025/26.

items.headline: Campbell agenda: rezoning 480 Chapman from commercial to single-family
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed a public hearing on an application from GKW Architects, for owners Joseph and Alicia Lam, to change 480 Chapman from Neighborhood Commercial to Low Density Residential and R-1-10 single-family zoning. The lot already has a single-family house, and the change would end its legal nonconforming status. Staff recommended that the commission forward the request to the City Council, tentatively set for December 1, 2026.

items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 251-unit Eden Housing project on N. Wolfe Road
items.summary: The November 10 Planning Commission agenda listed Architectural and Site Approval and Tree Removal Permits for Eden Housing's proposed 251-unit residential development at 10333 N. Wolfe Road. The application also covers site and trail improvements and the removal and replacement of 117 protected trees.
